english_research_meaning: The early visual brief explicitly favored a calm blue-gray/white/metallic Fluent-like desktop palette, outline icons, light borders, quiet motion, rounded panels and messenger-like center.
defeater_or_limit: This is a dated taste and accessibility hypothesis, not a mandatory theme, platform-wide brand palette or proven contrast/motion specification.

english_research_meaning: The proposed header kept the product title left and user menu right, while a left selector, central Scenario conversation and right contextual inspector formed the main working layout.
defeater_or_limit: Menu position and availability of restart/update actions require actual native and platform capability; they are not the authoritative current Windows screenshot or Product commitment.

english_research_meaning: The five navigation destinations used CBR escrow and raw-file collection as atomic examples, broad data refresh/report packages as composite examples and source checking/cache refresh as proposed background examples.
defeater_or_limit: Examples of an operation in a menu do not prove registry implementation, nor a real background scheduler, completeness of banking capabilities or safely executable update workflow.

english_research_meaning: The source proposed a Scenario as an ordered composite with dependencies, error rules and expected outputs; submission creates one user-visible Case collecting steps, operations, participants, events and result status.
defeater_or_limit: The proposed Case aggregation should not collapse identity of a reusable Scenario definition, accepted Run, actual Job Attempt or user chat Thread; current sequential runner does not prove all proposed dependency semantics.

english_research_meaning: Five original event-actor labels were human user, host user, AI, system and background process; the sketch proposed a common presentation of their attributed actions.
defeater_or_limit: Actor display labels alone do not authenticate a principal, authorize a machine action, prove a remote presence channel or establish that any AI or scheduler actually operated.

english_research_meaning: The original minimum desktop brief enumerated header, icon-only mode rail, mode panel, central Scenario chat, prelaunch bar, logs and Artifacts panes, parameter inspector, Explorer, participants/assignments, background view, user-menu settings and structured events.
defeater_or_limit: A long UI inventory is a design snapshot, not a set of independently justified Product commitments; later information architecture and Android/Web accessibility may require fewer/different surfaces.
